reviews.title: A Coach, Mentor, and Leader Who Continues to Stay Ahead of the Industry
reviews.body:
I've known Cory Long for nearly 10 years, and he has been a coach, teacher, and mentor to me and my business since 2021. Throughout that time, Cory and his team have never disappointed me. Having someone you can trust, learn from, and turn to as the industry continues to change means a lot.

I've been involved with AI and watching its impact on digital marketing for nearly three years now. AI search optimization is another big shift in our industry, and many business owners and marketing professionals still don't fully understand the opportunity in front of them.

What I like most about the AI Authority Engine program is that you're not just given a bunch of videos and told to go figure it out. You're learning and implementing the strategies as you go. If you don't understand something, you have the opportunity to ask questions and get answers. You're working through it together, which makes a big difference.

Something else I respect about Cory is that his approach goes beyond business. His Christian values, integrity, and genuine desire to help others succeed are evident in the way he leads and invests in people. It's refreshing to work with someone who values relationships, character, and helping others grow.

A couple of weeks ago, Cory brought together a small group of marketing agency owners who want to make a difference in this industry. That says a lot about the kind of person he is and the community he is building.

There are plenty of people out there selling courses and chasing the latest trend. Cory is someone who puts in the work, continues learning, shares what he knows, and genuinely wants to see others succeed.

I'm thankful for everything Cory has invested in me over the years, and I couldn't recommend Cory and his team more. If you're serious about understanding where search is heading and positioning your business for what's next, AI Authority Engine is worth looking into.

reviews.title: Setting the Standard for AI SEO Training & Certification
reviews.body:
I’m incredibly thankful for Cory Long and the way he has invested in my growth and development over the years. He has consistently been my go-to resource for just about everything related to online marketing, and I genuinely consider him to be one of the best in the industry.

One thing that has always set Cory apart is his ability to recognize where the industry is heading and stay ahead of the curve. That same forward-thinking approach has positioned him at the forefront of AI SEO, GEO, AEO (or whatever you want to call it). He has been developing, testing, and refining cutting-edge AI SEO strategies for over two years, long before AI SEO became a major topic of discussion in the marketing industry.

And that’s what makes his approach so valuable. These strategies aren’t something he threw together to capitalize on the latest marketing trend. They’re built on a system that was already in place before most people were even talking about AI search optimization. As the technology continues to evolve, so do his strategies, through ongoing testing, refinement, and real-world application.

The same forward-thinking mindset that established Cory’s expertise in traditional SEO has now carried over into his latest program, AI Authority Engine | AI SEO Certification & Training.

I genuinely believe Cory is helping set the standard of excellence in this rapidly evolving space. And that’s ultimately what makes this certification program so important. It’s about equipping professionals with the knowledge, strategies, and expertise needed to deliver effective AI SEO services, while giving business owners greater confidence in the specialists they choose to work with.

I’m extremely grateful to be part of this program and to have had the opportunity to learn from someone who has consistently stayed ahead of the industry.

I have absolutely zero reservations saying that I believe AI Authority Engine is the best AI SEO training and certification resource available today.
